Hedge Accounting by a First-time Adopter
Paragraphs B5 and B6 of IFRS 1 have been amended to include cross references to
the qualifying criteria for hedge accounting in paragraph 6.4.1(a), (b) and (c) of IFRS
9. These amendments are intended to address potential confusion arising from an
inconsistency between the wording in IFRS 1 and the requirements for hedge
accounting in IFRS 9.
